g.text: A compression merge absorbs an edited child
the batch deletes the key [1] and updates the key [2, 3] from 1 to 2;
the root keeps no endpoint and one child, so it merges with that child
predecessor s: 4 logical nodes, all loaded
successor t: 2 logical nodes, both placed
loaded: the namespace root is opened
: the root open and three expansions; no merge load,
because the merged child is a rebuilt node, not a reference
